You are re-reviewing whether code quality issues in the league drawer were fixed.

## Context
Previously you reviewed `apps/mobile/src/components/league-drawer.tsx` (Task 7, mobile league switcher) and found Important issues: missing safe-area insets, drawer avatar not resolving user image URL/cookie, profile route not existing (deferred to Task 9). Also minors: accessibility roles, same-league re-setActive, double-tap guard.

An implementer fixed them in commit `57a493f9`, also creating `apps/mobile/src/hooks/use-user-avatar.ts` and refactoring `app-header-left.tsx` to use it. Verify:

1. `league-drawer.tsx` now uses `useSafeAreaInsets()` with `paddingTop: insets.top + Spacing.five`, `paddingBottom: insets.bottom + Spacing.four`.
2. The drawer avatar uses the shared `useUserAvatar` hook (URL + cookie headers), not raw `user?.image`.
3. `app-header-left.tsx` was refactored to use the same hook (no duplicated inline logic).
4. League items + profile row have `accessibilityRole="button"`, active items have `accessibilityState={{ selected }}`.
5. Same-league press just closes the drawer (no setActive/invalidate).
6. `switchingId` state guards double-tap.
7. `router.push("/profile" as Href)` left as-is (Task 9 resolves it).

Check `use-user-avatar.ts` for correctness: URI resolution (http passthrough, else AUTH_BASE_URL/api/user-assets/encodeURIComponent), cookie fetch in effect with active guard, imageFailed reset on image change, returns uri/headers/imageFailed/onImageError.

Also run `git show --stat 57a493f9` (3 files, at HEAD), `cd apps/mobile && bun run typecheck` (zero errors).

Report:
- ✅ All fixed (or remaining issues)
- ❌ Remaining: [specifics with file:line]

content.text:
✅ **All fixed.**

Verified against `57a493f9` (3 files @ HEAD, typecheck clean — 0 errors):

1. ✅ Safe-area insets — `league-drawer.tsx:47` (`insets.top + Spacing.five` / `insets.bottom + Spacing.four`)
2. ✅ Drawer avatar via `useUserAvatar(user?.image)` — `league-drawer.tsx:21,51`
3. ✅ `app-header-left.tsx:12` uses the same hook — no duplicated inline logic
4. ✅ `accessibilityRole="button"` on league items (`:81`) + profile row (`:61`); `accessibilityState={{ selected: isActive }}` (`:82`)
5. ✅ Same-league press closes drawer only — `league-drawer.tsx:25-28`
6. ✅ `switchingId` guards double-tap — `:22,29-30,84`
7. ✅ `router.push("/profile" as Href)` left as-is — `:64`

**Hook correctness** (`use-user-avatar.ts`): URI resolution, cookie fetch w/ active guard all correct. One deviation from spec: the hook returns only `uri`/`headers` — not `imageFailed`/`onImageError`. But `imageFailed` reset-on-change + `onError` fallback live in the `Avatar` component (`avatar.tsx:27-41`), which both consumers share. Behavior is correct and no logic duplicated; just cleaner than the spec's proposed shape. Not a blocker.
